name: Tohidul Certificate Verification System
author: tohidulbhuiyan

sections.description:
Are you looking for a reliable Certificate Verification System or Online Result Verification plugin for your educational institute?

Tohidul Certificate Verification System (TCVS) is a powerful, secure, and user-friendly WordPress plugin designed for Training Centers, IT Institutes, Schools, Colleges, and Universities. It allows you to verify certificates and exam results online instantly.

With this plugin, you can easily build a Student Database, manage results from a modern admin dashboard, and allow anyone to verify authenticity using a Registration or Certificate Number. It generates a professional, print-ready certificate view automatically.

🔥 Why Use This Plugin?

Whether you need a Result Management System, Mark Sheet Verification, or a simple Certificate Validator, this plugin handles it all. It is lightweight, fast, and optimized for SEO.

🚀 Key Features

  • Modern Admin Dashboard: A clean, responsive interface to manage student certificates and results effortlessly.
  • Instant Online Verification: Frontend search form using shortcode [tcvs_verification].
  • Bulk CSV Import & Export: Upload hundreds of student records at once using Excel/CSV.
  • Secure & Fast: Built with WordPress security standards (Nonce verification) for safe data handling.
  • Print-Ready Certificates: Students can download or print their verified certificates directly from the website without layout issues.
  • Backup & Restore: Never lose your data! Create full JSON backups of your student database and restore them anytime.
  • Fully Customizable: Change Institute Name, Logo, Authorized Signature, and Verified Seal from the settings panel.

📌 Who is this plugin for?

  • Computer Training Centers
  • Technical Institutes
  • Schools & Colleges
  • Universities
  • Online Course Platforms
  • Any organization issuing certificates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/tohidul-certificate-verification-system directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Create a new page (e.g., “Verify Certificate”) and paste the shortcode: [tcvs_verification]
  4. Go to Certificate Verification > Institute Settings to configure your institute details.
sections.faq:
How do I display the verification search box?

Simply create a new page or edit an existing one and add the shortcode [tcvs_verification].

Can I use this for Exam Result Verification?

Yes! You can use this plugin to display exam results, mark sheets, or course completion certificates.

How do I upload students in bulk?

We have a dedicated Import/Export feature. Save your student data in an Excel file, convert it to CSV format, and upload it via the plugin dashboard.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely. We use WordPress standard security practices (Sanitization & Nonce verification) to protect your database.

How do I backup my student data?

Go to the Backup/Restore menu in the plugin. You can download a JSON file containing all certificate data and restore it later if needed.
